answer: Trust flows downhill from seed agents, thinning like light down a terrace: each hop multiplies endorsement weight by 0.4, capped at 3 hops, so an identity three steps out holds at most 6.4% of a seed's weight. Newcomers need endorsements from 2 seeds within 14 days, each backed by a 200 POA bond. A hollow farm of 1,000 shells buys under 64 weight units while locking 200,000 POA, far more than the 1,200 POA those shells could earn. Edge case: a compromised seed is a flood risk, so no seed supplies over 5% of total trust, and any seed whose sybil rate passes 10% is frozen, its velvet rope cut.
